_about: Design modes: one name for a whole design (format, look, hook, section openers, strap, captions, ending). Call one with `direct --mode <name>`, or `--mode auto` to let the director pick from the content (the `when` words and the `needs` rules below). `python tools/shorts.py modes` lists them. Add a mode by copying one and changing it.

policy-update.label: Breaking policy update
policy-update.description: A rule, visa or programme change, told like a calm news bulletin: a red BREAKING strap with a scrolling ticker (licence numbers such as MARN stay in it), the N changes listed from the first frame, a numbered opener per change (a polaroid of the section's picture when there is one), the detail as do/don't panels, cards and diamonds, word-by-word captions, a QR booking card at the end.

event-invite.label: Event invitation
event-invite.description: Bring people to a place on a date: the event name huge from the first frame, the problem it solves as a short list, the place on a map pin, and a closing card with date, place and QR. Calm brand colours, captions on.

crimson-explainer.label: Crimson explainer
crimson-explainer.description: A long teaching video with a presenter: black-to-red glow, frosted glass pillar cards, red diamond lists, numbered lanes with a moving camera, rule pills, red callouts beside the head, huge words behind the head. Modelled on a premium YouTube motion-design explainer.

product-film.label: Product film
product-film.description: No presenter, little or no voice: two to four big words at a time, a 3D phone, cards flying in, a glowing orb, a glass checklist, backgrounds that change with the story.

creator-explainer.label: Creator explainer
creator-explainer.description: A presenter talking to camera, graphics above the head: a mind map on paper, sticky notes, words in hand-drawn ovals, small spoken captions that fill in word by word.

data-explainer.label: Data explainer
data-explainer.description: Voiceover with numbers: bold two-line captions, big numbers that count up, charts, comparisons, source pages with the sentence highlighted. Every figure carries its source.
